Check statutory response deadlines for FBR Iris notices (Sec 114, 116, 122, 177) and calculate non-compliance penalty exposure.

Section 114 (Notice to File Return)

Issued by FBR for non-filing of annual income tax return.

Notice Reply Deadline
Statutory Response Window:30 Days from Receipt
Non-Compliance Penalty:Rs 40,000 or 0.1% of tax payable per day (Sec 182)
